name: aoreshkov-ai-tools
description: Claude Code plugins for Kotlin/JVM development and Oracle Forms modernization: multi-lens code review, Kotlin/Java library sources, Oracle Forms module inspection, a token-use audit of past sessions, and a live token meter above the prompt.

plugins.name: review-kit
plugins.description: Multi-lens code review as a dynamic workflow: plans the lenses that fit the repo, fans out read-only reviewers, adversarially verifies each finding, and writes one ranked report.

plugins.name: token-audit
plugins.description: Ranks a project's Claude Code sessions by token use and breaks the costliest down by action, large tool result and prompt, with habits to change. Needs Node 22+.

plugins.name: token-meter
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with the folder and git branch, model and effort, context use, rate limits and cost, and an alert line past 90%. A mod: needs Claude Code 2.1.287+.

plugins.name: kotlin-lib
plugins.description: Answers Kotlin/Java library questions from the real published sources jar — resolved signatures, KDoc, dependency tree and source search — instead of recalling them. Needs a JDK 25+, on PATH or configured by path.

plugins.name: oracle-forms
plugins.description: Read Oracle Forms modules (.fmb/.mmb/.pll/.olb) from a directory — blocks, items, triggers, program units, PL/SQL, and durable annotations. Needs a JDK 25+, on PATH or configured by path.
